summary: Elemental Royalty Corp filed a Form 6-K containing a notice of annual general and special meeting and a management information circular. The meeting scheduled for May 27, 2026 covers routine matters: receiving audited financials, fixing board size at five, electing directors, appointing PricewaterhouseCoopers as auditor, and approving amendments to the 2020 Omnibus Plan (reserving 10% of outstanding shares for awards). No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation is disclosed. This is a routine shareholder meeting filing with no event-driven catalyst.
